entries.what: Brakes lab at Tamsen Valley College from 8 to 11, bleeding a line with his bench partner and keeping the bay clean for Salas's grading.
entries.outcome: Finished the lab with the bay spotless.

entries.what: Drove the Taco home along Ruel Road and ate leftover pupusas before checking the week's stand prep list with Gladys.
entries.outcome: Prep list set for Thursday.

entries.what: Pickup soccer at Delgado Park in the evening, then teardown videos in bed.
entries.outcome: Slept by midnight.

entries.what: Engine performance with Salas from 1 to 4, tracing a misfire by ear before anyone pulled the scan tool.
entries.outcome: Got the diagnosis right and earned a nod.

entries.what: Election day: Oscar and Gladys voted at the community center and Rafael gave them a ride in the Taco on the way home from class.
entries.outcome: Parents voted on Measure K and he dropped them home.

entries.what: Did some stand errands, picking up pork from Ruiz Family Market for chicharrón at the family price.
entries.outcome: Stocked up for the weekend.

entries.what: Brakes lab in the morning, then late at night worked through G1 practice questions with the assistant.
entries.outcome: Went through a set of questions and finished with a clearer picture of each system.

entries.what: Asked the assistant to explain each practice answer as what you'd actually see in the bay, since the book wording lost him.
entries.outcome: The bay-style explanations made the answers stick.

entries.what: Recorded a few answers as voice memos to play while prepping the griddle.
entries.outcome: Added to his flashcard memos.

entries.what: Engine performance class from 1 to 4, then loaded the canopy and generator into the Taco.
entries.outcome: Headed to the stand on time.

entries.what: Worked the Thursday evening shift at the Ruel Road lot, running the griddle from 5 to 10 with the flashcard memos in his earbuds.
entries.outcome: Decent sales, home by 10:30.

entries.what: Watched an engine teardown video before bed.
entries.outcome: Fell asleep close to midnight.

entries.what: Spent the day at the shop-class lab and picked up a ride request for Dulce, who works Friday 4 to 9.
entries.outcome: Plan locked for the evening pickup.

entries.what: Worked the Ruel Road stand from 5 and left at 8:50 to get Dulce from Taquería Colima, back by 9:20.
entries.outcome: Dulce got home safe and he was back at the griddle.

entries.what: Closed the stand with Oscar and tallied the cash box with Gladys's green notebook.
entries.outcome: Numbers matched.

entries.what: Met Dante at the shop. Dante pitched his Civic-flip, and Rafael said he would do mechanical work for 30% of profit but put no cash in, which settled his earlier undecided stance.
entries.outcome: Agreed to labor-only work on one Civic for 30% of profit.

entries.what: Asked the assistant for a simple written agreement for the labor-only profit sharing so nothing gets fuzzy later.
entries.outcome: Got a short draft to show Dante.

entries.what: Paid Dante back the $120 for the lost sockets as part of settling up.
entries.outcome: Debt cleared.

entries.what: Worked the Saturday night stand at Ruel Road with Ximena helping.
entries.outcome: Busy night, good sales.

entries.what: Slept in, then went to Spanish Mass-adjacent family breakfast and helped Gladys with errands.
entries.outcome: Errands done.

entries.what: Serviced the generator in the driveway before the Sunday evening stand.
entries.outcome: Generator ready.

entries.what: Worked the Sunday stand from 5 to 10 and cleaned up with the family.
entries.outcome: Closed the weekend with solid sales.

new_facts.subject: rafael
new_facts.value: drove his parents to vote at the community center on election day

new_facts.subject: rafael
new_facts.value: Saturday stand night was the best of the month so far
